description: This Java class 'SensorCentral' manages sensor values and listeners, providing methods to get/set sensor data, add/remove listeners, initialize sensor values from engine state, and handle sensor updates. It implements the ISensorCentral interface and defines inner interfaces for sensor listeners.

classes.name: SensorCentral
classes.description: Manages sensor values and listeners, provides sensor data access, and initializes sensor states.

classes.name: SensorCentral.SensorListener
classes.description: Interface for receiving sensor value updates.

classes.name: SensorCentral.SensorListener2
classes.description: Interface for receiving sensor updates with sensor reference.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SensorCentral.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of a specified sensor.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a new value for a specified sensor and notifies listeners if updated.

methods.name: setAnySensorListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for updates from any sensor.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener for a specific sensor.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener for a specific sensor.

methods.name: getValueSource
methods.description: Provides a ValueSource functional interface for a sensor.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes sensor values from the engine state.
